display_name: What describes the time you chose to go to bed last night?
description:
-1 = No major factors influenced my decision; I just went to bed when I wanted
1 = Early because of morning event
2 = Early because of fatigue
3 = Early because of illness
4 = Delayed due to an academic deadline(s)
5 ='Delayed studying or working on an academic project
6 = Delayed for social reasons
7 ='Delayed due to an extracurricular activity
8 = Delayed due to employment
9 = 'Delayed due to media (Netflix, social media) 
10 =Couldn't fall asleep 
11 =Other
